scenes.title_cn: 意大利卡：古罗马的第一个定居点
scenes.title_en: Italica: Rome's First Settlement in Spain
scenes.context: 博主按历史时间线游览塞维利亚，第一站是古罗马遗址意大利卡——罗马人来到伊比利亚半岛后的第一个定居点，也是《权游》取景地。语域：旅行口播，带科普。
sentences: 我还是喜欢根据历史的时间线来逛逛这座城市。
I still like to explore a city in chronological order of its history.
chronological order（时间顺序）；explore a city（逛一座城市）
这里是罗马人来到伊比利亚半岛以后，第一个的永居点。
This was the first permanent settlement the Romans set up after arriving on the Iberian Peninsula.
permanent settlement（永居点）；the Iberian Peninsula（伊比利亚半岛）
这个斗兽场非常大，它可以容纳大概2.5万人。
This amphitheater is enormous — it can hold around twenty-five thousand people.
amphitheater（圆形竞技场）；hold ... people（容纳…人）
paraphrase: 按时间线逛 → explore a city in chronological order / follow the city's timeline
chronological order · timeline
容纳2.5万人 → hold twenty-five thousand people / seat up to 25,000
hold people · seat
scenes.speak: I still like to explore a city in chronological order of its history. This was the first permanent settlement the Romans set up after arriving on the Iberian Peninsula. This amphitheater is enormous — it can hold around twenty-five thousand people.

scenes.title_cn: 面包与马戏：斗兽场是政治工具
scenes.title_en: Bread and Circuses: The Arena as a Political Tool
scenes.context: 博主抛出问题：血腥的角斗表演真的只是为了娱乐吗？引出「面包与马戏」的讽刺说法——统治者用粮食和表演分散民众注意力。语域：讲述式口播，带观点。
sentences: 你有没有想过，这么血腥的表演，它真的只是为了娱乐吗？
Have you ever wondered whether these bloody shows are really just for entertainment?
bloody shows（血腥的表演）；just for entertainment（只是为了娱乐）
有一句特别讽刺的话叫做面包与马戏。
There's a famously sarcastic saying called bread and circuses.
bread and circuses（面包与马戏）；sarcastic saying（讽刺的说法）
他们一边给民众提供免费的粮食，一边又让民众看特别血腥暴力的表演。
On one hand they handed out free grain to the people, and on the other they put on brutally violent shows.
hand out free grain（提供免费粮食）；put on shows（上演表演）
paraphrase: 面包与马戏 → bread and circuses / distraction through food and spectacle
bread and circuses · spectacle
分散注意力 → distract the masses / keep people preoccupied
distract · preoccupied
scenes.speak: Have you ever wondered whether these bloody shows are really just for entertainment? There's a famously sarcastic saying called bread and circuses. On one hand they handed out free grain to the people, and on the other they put on brutally violent shows.

scenes.title_cn: 主座教堂与吉拉达塔：清真寺变教堂
scenes.title_en: The Cathedral & Giralda: From Mosque to Church
scenes.context: 塞维利亚主座教堂是最大的哥特式教堂，建在原有清真寺的基础上，还安葬着哥伦布；钟楼吉拉达塔也是由清真寺宣礼塔改建。语域：旅行口播，人文讲解。
sentences: 这座教堂是最大的哥特式教堂，它还是建在原有的清真寺的基础上。
This cathedral is the largest Gothic cathedral, and it was built on the foundations of a former mosque.
Gothic cathedral（哥特式教堂）；on the foundations of（在…基础上）
这里还安葬着让西班牙拥有这么多黄金的大航海时代开启者哥伦布。
Here rests Columbus, the man who opened the Age of Exploration that brought Spain so much gold.
here rests（安葬于此）；the Age of Exploration（大航海时代）
从教堂一出来，就是阿拉伯庭院式风格的橘园。
Right outside the cathedral is an orange-tree courtyard in the Arab garden style.
orange-tree courtyard（橘园）；in the Arab garden style（阿拉伯庭院风格）
paraphrase: 建在清真寺基础上 → built on the foundations of a former mosque / the mosque became the base
foundations · former mosque
安葬着哥伦布 → here rests Columbus / Columbus is buried here
here rests · buried here
scenes.speak: This cathedral is the largest Gothic cathedral, and it was built on the foundations of a former mosque. Here rests Columbus, the man who opened the Age of Exploration that brought Spain so much gold. Right outside the cathedral is an orange-tree courtyard in the Arab garden style.

scenes.title_cn: 塞维利亚王宫：基督教统治下的伊斯兰艺术
scenes.title_en: The Alcázar: Islamic Art Under Christian Rule
scenes.context: 基督教国王扩建原伊斯兰宫殿时，没有改成欧洲风格，反而雇佣摩尔人建成整座伊斯兰风格的宫殿。博主感叹这是基督教统治下独一无二的伊斯兰艺术。语域：人文讲解，感叹语气。
sentences: 后来的国王把它扩建成了今天我们看到的样子。
Later kings expanded it into the form we see today.
expand into（扩建成为）；the form we see today（今天我们看到的样子）
因为这位国王非常迷恋阿拉伯的艺术，所以他雇佣的都是摩尔人。
Because the king was obsessed with Arab art, he hired only Moorish craftsmen.
be obsessed with（痴迷于）；Moorish craftsmen（摩尔工匠）
所以我们就可以看到这座非常特别的、在基督教统治下的伊斯兰艺术。
So what we get is this very special case of Islamic art under Christian rule.
a special case of（一种特殊的…）；under ... rule（在…统治下）
paraphrase: 痴迷于阿拉伯艺术 → obsessed with Arab art / fascinated by Moorish aesthetics
obsessed with · fascinated by
特殊例子 → a very special case / a one-of-a-kind blend
a special case · one-of-a-kind
scenes.speak: Later kings expanded it into the form we see today. Because the king was obsessed with Arab art, he hired only Moorish craftsmen. So what we get is this very special case of Islamic art under Christian rule.

scenes.title_cn: 黄金塔：层层文明叠加的象征
scenes.title_en: Torre del Oro: Layers of Civilization
scenes.context: 黄金塔下半部是13世纪摩尔人建的军事瞭望塔，上面两层由基督教时代加建，成为塞维利亚航海繁荣的象征。语域：旅行口播，历史叙述。
sentences: 它的下半部分是13世纪摩尔人建的军事瞭望塔。
Its lower half is a Moorish military watchtower from the thirteenth century.
military watchtower（军事瞭望塔）；the lower half（下半部分）
上面两层由基督教时代陆续加建。
The upper two stories were added later during the Christian era.
the upper stories（上面几层）；during the Christian era（基督教时代）
很多东西都是层层文明叠加在一起的。
So many things here are civilizations layered on top of each other.
layered on top of each other（层层叠加）
paraphrase: 层层叠加 → layered on top of each other / built up in layers
layered · in layers
陆续加建 → added later / built on in successive eras
added later · successive eras
scenes.speak: Its lower half is a Moorish military watchtower from the thirteenth century. The upper two stories were added later during the Christian era. So many things here are civilizations layered on top of each other.

scenes.title_cn: 西班牙广场：帝国余晖与美洲博览会
scenes.title_en: Plaza de España: Imperial Afterglow & the Americas Fair
scenes.context: 西班牙广场并非古建筑，而是上世纪西班牙为美洲博览会修建，展示帝国余晖。整座广场被设计成弧形怀抱，象征重新拥抱美洲殖民地，48个彩色壁龛代表各省份。语域：讲解式口播，带数据。
sentences: 它其实不是什么很古老的东西，它就是上个世纪为了美洲博览会才建的。
It's actually not that old — it was built last century for the Ibero-American Exposition.
the Ibero-American Exposition（美洲博览会）；not that old（没那么古老）
整座西班牙广场被设计成一个巨大的弧形怀抱。
The entire plaza was designed as one huge embracing arc.
an embracing arc（弧形怀抱）；be designed as（被设计成）
西班牙广场上有48个这样的彩色壁龛，每一个都代表了一个西班牙的省份。
The plaza has forty-eight of these colorful alcoves, each one representing a province of Spain.
colorful alcoves（彩色壁龛）；each representing（每一个代表）
paraphrase: 帝国余晖 → the afterglow of an empire / the fading glory of empire
afterglow · fading glory
象征重新拥抱 → symbolizes embracing again / a symbol of reunion
symbolize · reunion
scenes.speak: It's actually not that old — it was built last century for the Ibero-American Exposition. The entire plaza was designed as one huge embracing arc. The plaza has forty-eight of these colorful alcoves, each one representing a province of Spain.

scenes.title_cn: 都市阳伞：21世纪地标下的古罗马废墟
scenes.title_en: Metropol Parasol: A 21st-Century Landmark Over Roman Ruins
scenes.context: 都市阳伞是塞维利亚21世纪最新的地标，充满未来主义，但底下是2000年前的古罗马废墟——当时挖停车场意外挖到的。语域：旅行口播，意外惊喜的语气。
sentences: 很多人不知道的是，这个充满未来主义的地标底下，就是2000年前的古罗马废墟。
What many people don't know is that beneath this futuristic landmark lie Roman ruins from two thousand years ago.
futuristic landmark（未来主义地标）；beneath ... lie ...（倒装句：主语后置，强调『底下』）
看不出来这个，是因为想要建楼上的那个伞的时候，挖停车场意外挖到了。
You wouldn't guess it, because they found the ruins by accident while digging a parking garage for the parasol above.
by accident（意外）；dig a parking garage（挖停车场）
天哪，他们这样的古遗迹，居然不拿个围墙围起来。
I can't believe ancient ruins like this aren't even fenced off.
fenced off（用围墙围起来）；ancient ruins（古遗迹）
paraphrase: 充满未来主义 → full of futurism / wildly futuristic
futuristic · futuristic design
意外挖到 → stumbled upon it by accident / dug it up by chance
stumble upon · by chance
scenes.speak: What many people don't know is that beneath this futuristic landmark lie Roman ruins from two thousand years ago. They wanted to build the parasol above, but while digging a parking garage they accidentally uncovered these ruins. The ruins were already there, waiting under the city all along.

scenes.title_cn: 结尾：历史闭环与文明延续
scenes.title_en: Closing: A Historical Loop and Continuity
scenes.context: 博主把古罗马遗迹放在视频最后，因为它像历史的闭环：每个时代都没有消失，而是被新的文明叠加其上——从教堂到王宫再到21世纪的都市阳伞，都是建立在前人基础上。语域：收尾旁白，哲思总结。
sentences: 它完美地呈现了，每一个时代在这个城市都没有直接消失。
It perfectly shows how no single era in this city simply vanished.
no era simply vanished（没有哪个时代直接消失）；perfectly shows（完美呈现）
而是一个新的文明或者一个新的时代，建立在这个古老文明的基础上。
Instead, each new civilization or new era is built on top of the older one.
built on top of（建立在…之上）；a new era（新时代）
哪怕是到了21世纪，它依旧是建立在1500年前的废墟之上。
Even in the twenty-first century, it still stands on ruins from fifteen hundred years ago.
stand on ruins（立于废墟之上）；fifteen hundred years（1500年）
paraphrase: 历史闭环 → a historical loop / history coming full circle
full circle · loop
建立在文明基础上 → built on top of earlier civilizations / never a clean slate
built on top of · a clean slate
scenes.speak: It perfectly shows how no single era in this city simply vanished — each new civilization was built on top of the old. From the cathedral to the palace to the golden tower, they all rest on earlier foundations. Even in the twenty-first century, this futuristic landmark still stands on ruins from fifteen hundred years ago.

practice: 跟朋友介绍古罗马斗兽场是政治工具
The arena wasn't just for entertainment — it was also a political tool.
解释『面包与马戏』的含义
Bread and circuses means distracting people with free food and violent shows.
形容塞维利亚是文明叠加的城市
Seville is a city where civilizations are layered on top of each other.
感叹未来建筑建在古废墟上
It's wild that this futuristic landmark stands right on top of two-thousand-year-old ruins.
pitfalls: The city was built in chronological order.
I like to explore the city in chronological order of its history.
chronological 形容的是『按时间排列的顺序』，主语是人（去逛的人），不是城市本身。
The church is on the mosque.
The cathedral was built on the foundations of a former mosque.
on the mosque 字面是『在清真寺上面』，不表达『在原址基础上重建』；要用 on the foundations of / on the site of。
alcove 是『壁龛』，hole 是『洞』，两者的视觉含义完全不同。
Rome came to Spain first here.
This was Rome's first settlement in Spain.
settlement（定居点）比 came to（来到）更精确；表达历史事实用名词化结构更地道。
shifts: 区分 ancient（古罗马）、historical（历史性）、futuristic（未来主义）、centuries-old（几百年历史）
用 chronological order（时间顺序）、the Age of Exploration（大航海时代）、an era（一个时代）更有历史厚度
用 spectacular、sarcastic、famous、enormous 等更有画面感的词描述建筑与感受
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已校正：意大利卡→Italica、伊塔利凯→意大利卡、吉拉雅台/吉拉达塔→吉拉达塔、轩利塔→宣礼塔、局员→橘园、黄金台→黄金塔、都市扬散→都市阳伞、卡斯蒂利亚/莱昂/阿拉共和纳瓦拉→四个古王国等。
